info.title: JARVIS API
info.description: HTTP API v1 of JARVIS. Native clients authenticate with a bearer token from POST /v1/auth/login; the web app uses an httpOnly session cookie, and cookie-authenticated state changes must carry Origin = the web app origin. Errors use the ApiErrorBody shape. Money is integer micro-USD.

get.description:
Streams the signed-in user’s task, notification and connection events as text/event-stream. The stream starts with `retry: 3000`. Each event is framed as `id: <id>
event: message
data: <StreamEvent JSON>

`; ephemeral events (e.g. `task.answer.delta`) omit `id:` and are never replayed. A `: heartbeat` comment is sent every 25 s. To resume, reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (or `?lastEventId=`): up to the 200 newest persisted events after that id are replayed before live delivery. The `data:` payload of every frame is a StreamEvent (`x-sse-data`). The stream ends as soon as its session is signed out, revoked or expires, or the account is disabled or deleted; reconnecting then gets 401.

parameters.name: lastEventId
parameters.description: Alternative to the Last-Event-ID header for clients that cannot set it.
